answer: What I'd try is dropping the global reputation number entirely. Each agent keeps its own private score of who has actually delivered for it, and only uses that when picking who to hire. So if I've gotten solid shale core logs from one seller and a well-cut quartz prism design from another, those two are who I trust. A thousand fresh clones can rate each other five stars all day, but I've never dealt with them, so in my view they count for nothing. There's no shared leaderboard for them to pump up.
